originalTitle: The new Apple TV 4K just got its first (very small) discount

content: Earlier this week, Apple announced its new Apple TV 4K, which costs nearly twice as much as the 2022 model did at launch. Amazon is now offering the first discount on the forthcoming streaming box (coming out on November 13th), just days after discounting Apple’s new smart display for the first time. Right now, you can preorder the latest Apple TV 4K ahead of its November 13th release date for $289.99 ($9 off) at Amazon. Yes, it’s a tiny discount, but every little bit helps given the higher price tag. [Product: Apple TV 4K (2026) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMX69N2K?tag=theverge02-20] Powered by the new A19 chip, Apple’s latest streaming device now features support for Siri AI out of the box, which is coming to older Apple TV 4K models via a software update. Unlike its predecessors, though, the new model features far-field microphones so you can quickly make hands-free requests. You can, for example, ask for recommendations, like nature documentaries available on Apple TV, or ask questions about what you’re watching. Siri AI can also understand personal context, too, so long as you have an iPhone or iPad connected to your account that supports Apple Intelligence. Apple has made a few other welcome upgrades, though — as my colleague John Higgins points out — not as many as some may have expected. While Apple skipped features we’d hope to see on a $300 streamer, like audio passthrough and support for 120fps output, it’s nice that the Siri Remote now supports Find My precision tracking, so you can make it ring when it goes missing or use the Find My app on your iPhone to pinpoint its location. The new Apple TV 4K also supports a more expansive surround-sound setup, allowing you to pair up to four compatible HomePod speakers instead of just two. Read our hands-on impressions of the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K. Three more Verge-approved deals: * If you’ve been meaning to pick up Pikmin 4, Walmart is selling a digital copy for $39.88 ($20 off), which is a great price considering most other retailers are still charging the full $59.99. It’s the original Switch version, but you can upgrade to the forthcoming Nintendo Switch 2 Edition when it arrives on November 12th by purchasing a separate $9.99 upgrade pack, which adds improved graphics and a new Dandori Academy mode. That brings your total to just $49.87, saving you about $20 compared to buying the $69.99 Switch 2 Edition outright. Read our review. * All eyes might be on the iPhone Duo — which is now available to preorder, despite shipments being delayed into 2027  — but if you have a non-foldable iPhone, Woot is currently discounting a wide range of Otterbox cases through October 31st. I’ve owned several of the brand’s cases for both my smartphones and tablets over the years, and I’ve been impressed by their durability. I currently use the OtterBox Symmetry Series Clear Case for my iPhone 16, which normally costs $49.99 but is now available in various colors for just $5.99 with a 90-day warranty. The sale also includes cases for other iPhones, as well as some Samsung and Google phones, so it’s worth browsing even if you’re not planning to upgrade your phone anytime soon. * Fanttik’s S1 Pro electric screwdriver is on sale for $45.99 ($44 off) at Amazon, which is $5 shy of its best price to date. It’s a handy cordless option for small tasks ranging from tightening screws to assembling desks, with 16 S2 hardened steel bits for tackling a variety of jobs. The USB-C rechargeable screwdriver also comes with a 220RPM motor and three torque settings, along with a LED light to help illuminate your workspace.
chineseTitle: 新款 Apple TV 4K 刚刚获得第一个（非常小的）折扣

chineseContent: 本周早些时候，苹果宣布推出新款 Apple TV 4K，其价格几乎是 2022 年型号发布时的两倍。亚马逊现在对即将推出的流媒体盒（11 月 13 日推出）提供首次折扣，而就在几天前，苹果公司的新款智能显示屏首次打折。现在，您可以在 11 月 13 日发布之前在 Amazon 上以 289.99 美元（优惠 9 美元）的价格预订最新款 Apple TV 4K。是的，这是一个很小的折扣，但考虑到更高的价格标签，每一点都会有所帮助。 [产品：Apple TV 4K (2026) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMX69N2K?tag=theverge02-20] Apple 最新的流媒体设备由新的 A19 芯片提供支持，现在支持 Siri AI，该功能将通过软件更新提供给旧款 Apple TV 4K 型号。不过，与前代产品不同的是，新型号配备了远场麦克风，因此您可以快速提出免提请求。例如，您可以寻求建议，例如 Apple TV 上提供的自然纪录片，或者询问有关您正在观看的内容的问题。只要您的 iPhone 或 iPad 连接到支持 Apple Intelligence 的帐户，Siri AI 也可以理解个人背景。不过，正如我的同事约翰·希金斯（John Higgins）指出的那样，苹果还进行了其他一些受欢迎的升级，但数量没有一些人预期的那么多。虽然苹果跳过了我们希望在 300 美元的流媒体上看到的功能，比如音频直通和支持 120fps 输出，但很高兴 Siri Remote 现在支持“查找我的”精确跟踪，因此您可以在它丢失时让它响铃，或者使用 iPhone 上的“查找我的”应用程序来精确定位它的位置。新款 Apple TV 4K 还支持更广泛的环绕声设置，让您最多可以配对四个兼容的 HomePod 扬声器，而不仅仅是两个。阅读我们的实践印象
